name: specgate-studio
description: An IDE for spec-driven development, with specgate underneath

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/protocol packages/adapter-specgate-cli packages/adapter-specgate-api packages/adapter-node packages/adapter-pty-node packages/host apps/cli apps/desktop && tsc -p apps/ui/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/ui/tsconfig.json && npm run build -w @specgate-studio/ui
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/protocol packages/adapter-specgate-cli packages/adapter-specgate-api packages/adapter-node packages/adapter-pty-node packages/host apps/cli apps/desktop
